headline: Starbucks stock gains as sales growth outpaces expectations
summary: Starbucks (SBUX) is out with its fiscal third quarter results, topping earnings ($0.85 vs. estimates of $0.65) and net revenue expectations ($9.3 billion vs. estimates of $9.16 billion). The stock is jumping in Wednesday's after-hours trading. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma dives into the coffee giant's same-store sales growth and its decision to raise its full-year 2026 guidance.

headline: Chipotle (NYSE:CMG) Reports Q2 CY2026 In Line With Expectations, Stock Soars
summary: Mexican fast-food chain Chipotle (NYSE:CMG) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 9.3% year on year to $3.35 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.33 per share was 4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
